blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Farm Fresh opened its PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on a high note, dominating Galeries Tower, 25-23, 25-22, 25-15, on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The Foxies flexed their depth and thrived in the all-to-play format, with Mylene Paat-Rezanova coming off the bench as the top scorer with 14 points. READ: PVL to crown a Philippine Grand Champion for 10th season Paat-Rezanova, a 10-year veteran, was a substitute for reigning PVL Season MVP Trisha Tubu and started in the last two.
